paragraphs: We are a commercial-stage medical device company, incorporated in 1998 as a Delaware corporation, that develops and commercializes integrated systems used in minimally invasive neurosurgical procedures in the brain. From our inception in 1998, we have deployed significant resources to fund our efforts to develop the foundational capabilities for enabling magnetic resonance imaging ("MRI") guided interventions, building an intellectual property portfolio, and identifying and building out commercial applications for the technologies we develop. In 2021, our efforts expanded beyond the MRI suite to encompass development and commercialization of neurosurgical device products for the operating room setting, as well as consulting services for pharmaceutical companies.

In 2025, through our acquisition of IRRAS Holdings, Inc. ("IRRAS"), we expanded our portfolio into neurocritical care. IRRAS is a commercial-stage medical technology company focused on treatments for intracerebral hemorrhage, intraventricular hemorrhage, and other conditions requiring intracranial fluid management.

The IRRAS products complement our existing neurosurgical technologies and broaden our reach into acute care settings, enabling us to offer an expanded set of solutions spanning functional neurosurgery, neurocritical care, and intracranial drug delivery.

Our business consists of two integrated components: (i) a business providing medical devices for neurosurgical applications, and (ii) a business focused on partnerships in the biologics and drug delivery space.
Medical Devices for Neurosurgical Application
The first foundational component of our business is focused on providing medical devices for neurosurgical applications.

Our primary medical device product, the ClearPoint system, is an integrated system comprised of hardware components, disposable components, and intuitive, menu-driven software. The primary applications for the ClearPoint system are to target and guide: (a) the insertion of deep brain stimulation electrodes, biopsy needles, and laser catheters; and (b) the infusion of pharmaceuticals into the brain. The ClearPoint system was originally designed for use in an MRI setting. In 2021, we launched the SmartFrame Array Neuro Navigation System and Software, which allows for operating room placement of the ClearPoint system and completion of the procedure in the MRI suite. In 2024, we introduced the SmartFrame OR Stereotactic System to the market, which allows for complete procedures to be performed in the operating room. In 2025, we released the ClearPoint Navigation Software Version 3.0, which allows for the ClearPoint system navigation software to support end-to-end procedures in the operating room.

In 2022, we commenced commercialization of the ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System, a laser ablation system. The ClearPoint Prism Neuro Laser Therapy System was developed and is manufactured for us by CLS. We have exclusive global rights to commercialize the system for neuro applications.

In 2025, through the acquisition of IRRAS, we added the IRRAflow Active Fluid Exchange System (the "IRRAflow system") to our portfolio of medical devices. The IRRAflow system integrates continuous irrigation, drainage, and real-time intracranial pressure monitoring to provide controlled, automated intracranial fluid management within neurocritical care and operating room settings.

The second component of our business is focused on partnerships in the biologics and drug delivery space, supporting our customers from the earliest stages of their research through their clinical study and commercialization process. Since 2021, a growing and significant part of the revenue from our business is derived from preclinical development services, which include protocol consultation and solutions for preclinical study design and execution. Our consulting services include a core competency of in vivo biology services in large and small research models to assist our customers with establishing drug safety prior to and in support of their human clinical trials.

Currently, we have more than 60 pharma/biotech, academic, and contract research organization partners who are evaluating or using our products and services in trials to inject gene and cell therapies directly into the brain. These partnerships involve drug development programs that are at various stages of development ranging from preclinical research to late-stage regulatory trials for multiple distinct disease states. This part of our business potentially represents the largest opportunity for growth; however, our ability to grow in this market is dependent on our ability to maintain and establish new relationships with pharmaceutical company customers, such customers' continuation of research and product development plans, such customers achieving success in completion of clinical trials and subsequent regulatory approvals of their drugs and biologics, and such customers' realization of commercial success for their therapies, including overcoming barriers in reimbursement, physician adoption, and patient access to their therapies. In 2024, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") granted marketing authorization for our SmartFlow Neuro cannula to be used to deliver a gene therapy for the treatment of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase ("AADC") deficiency directly to regions of interest within the brain.
Our ClearPoint system is an integrated system comprised of hardware components, disposable components and intuitive, menu-driven software.

ClearPoint Hardware. Our hardware components consist primarily of a head fixation frame, computer workstation and in-room monitor. The head fixation frame immobilizes the patient's head during the procedure, and it is designed to optimize the placement of an imaging head coil in proximity to the patient's head. When performed in the MRI suite, the ClearPoint system software is installed on a computer workstation networked with an MRI scanner, for which we use a commercially available laptop computer. The in-room monitor allows the physician to view the display of our ClearPoint system workstation from the scanner room while performing the procedure.

ClearPoint Disposables. The disposable components of our ClearPoint system consist primarily of our series of SmartFrame trajectory device, a hand controller and related accessories, and our SmartFlow Neuro cannula. Our SmartFrame devices are an adjustable trajectory guide that attaches to the patient's skull and holds the targeting cannula. In the MRI, a hand controller attaches to our SmartFrame device, and it is used by the physician to adjust the roll, pitch, and X and Y orientation of the targeting cannula while the patient is in the MRI scanner. The accessories include all other components necessary to facilitate the image-guided neurosurgical procedures, such as our SmartGrid patch, which is an MRI-visible marking grid that enables rapid localization of the entry position into the brain, and our customized surgical draping, which creates a sterile field within the MRI scanner. The SmartFrame OR Stereotactic System is a single use disposable that does not require MRI guidance. For drug delivery procedures, our SmartFlow Neuro cannula, which is an MRI-compatible injection and aspiration cannula, serves as the vehicle for the delivery of the compound.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
Our business, financial condition, and results of operations may be adversely affected by general economic and financial market conditions and current and future social and geopolitical instability.
If we cannot maintain our current relationships or programs, or enter into new relationships or programs, with drug delivery customers, our revenue prospects could be meaningfully reduced.
The sizes of the markets for our products and services and any future products and services may be smaller than we estimate and may decline.
Our ClearPoint system and our IRRAflow system may not achieve broad market adoption.
Limitations in the existing clinical evidence for the IRRAflow system may affect clinical and commercial adoption.

We currently have significant customer concentration, so economic difficulties or changes in the purchasing policies or patterns of our key customers could have a significant impact on our business and operating results.
We rely on single facilities for manufacturing and performance of services, which exposes us to significant risk of disruption.
Our reliance on single-source suppliers for components, finished products and services could harm our ability to meet demand for our products or services in a timely manner or within budget.
Our use of hazardous materials in manufacturing and in the conduct of services may exposes us to significant health, safety, environmental, and regulatory risks.

To the extent we seek a new indication for use of, or new claims for, our products, the FDA may not grant 510(k) clearance or PMA approval of such new use or claims, which may affect our ability to grow our business.
If we fail to obtain the necessary clearances, certifications or approvals for our new products, our ability to grow our business globally could be harmed.

We sell our products outside of the U.S., and we are subject to various economic, political, regulatory, and other risks relating to international operations, which could harm our revenue and profitability.
paragraphs: Any investment in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below and all information contained in this Annual Report before you decide whether to purchase our common stock. If any of the following risks or uncertainties actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects would likely suffer, possibly materially. In addition, the trading price of our common stock could decline due to any of these risks or uncertainties, and you may lose part or all of your investment. The matters described below reflect our beliefs and views as to factors, events or contingencies that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and growth prospects, and/or the price of our common shares in the future. References in this section to past events or conditions are provided by way of

example only and are not intended to be a complete listing or a representation as to whether or not the factors,events or contingencies discussed below have occurred in the past or their likelihood of occurring in the future.

Changes in domestic and global economic conditions, such as persistent inflationary pressure, higher interest rates, changes in monetary policy, declining consumer and business confidence and spending, supply chain disruptions, the introduction of or changes in tariffs or trade barriers, and the potential for global or local recession may adversely impact the demand for our products and services, which could negatively impact our business, financial conditions, and results of operations. The world's financial markets remain susceptible to significant stresses, including reduced liquidity and access to credit, increased borrowing costs, foreign currency fluctuations, and volatility in the valuations of securities generally. As a result, our ability to access capital markets or other funding sources in the future may be limited or may not be available on commercially reasonable terms, if at all.

Inflationary pressures and elevated interest rates could increase our costs for research and development, supply chain, labor, and other administrative expenses, which could in turn raise the cost of producing and distributing our products and services. In such environments, we may be unable to increase prices sufficiently to offset these higher costs. These impacts could be more pronounced in areas of our business where pricing is governed by long-term contractual arrangements, as we may not be able to quickly or easily adjust pricing, reduce costs, or implement countermeasures.

In addition, our hospital, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology customers may experience heightened financial and operational pressures as a result of macroeconomic conditions. Such pressures may include increased cost of funding, reduced access to capital markets, cash flow challenges, or difficulties complying with debt covenants. These conditions could, in turn, impede our hospital customers' ability to provide patient care or reduce budgets for new capital equipment and technologies. Government funding cuts have further constrained hospital and healthcare system budgets, which may limit their ability to invest in new technologies and slow adoption of our products. Our pharmaceutical and biotechnology customers who are engaged in gene and cell therapy development, may face reduced availability of research and development funding, which could slow the pace of innovation, delay clinical trials, or constrain commercialization efforts. Any such customer constraints may adversely affect their willingness or ability to purchase our products and services, or may impair their ability to make timely payments, either of which could negatively impact our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Moreover, broader economic uncertainty, elevated unemployment levels, and rising health insurance premiums, co-payments, and deductibles may lead to cost-conscious consumers pursuing fewer elective or advanced medical treatments, which could reduce procedure volumes and demand for our products and services.

Geopolitical changes and trends such as populism, protectionism, economic nationalism, as well as tariffs, sanctions, and other trade restrictions may become disruptive and costly to our business. The global economy has been, and may continue to be, negatively affected by ongoing conflicts, including Russia's invasion of Ukraine, instability in the Middle East, and heightened tensions in the Asia-Pacific region, particularly with respect to China and Taiwan. These developments may interfere with our supply chain, manufacturing costs, access to raw materials, and customer relationships. In addition, market uncertainty and volatility in various geographies may be magnified as a result of shifts in U.S. and foreign trade, economic, and regulatory policies following recent elections. Geopolitical uncertainty has also prompted many pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to prefer sourcing from suppliers located closer to their manufacturing and research operations, or within their home markets, as a strategy to reduce exposure to security risks and cross-border disruptions. If we are unable to align with these preferences or establish sufficient local presence in key markets, our competitiveness with respect to certain international customers may be diminished. Although the majority of our operations are based in the United States, further escalation of geopolitical tensions could make it more costly or difficult to maintain our current international business or expand into additional markets, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家商業化階段的醫療器材公司，於1998年在特拉華州成立為一家公司，專門開發並商業化用於腦部微創神經外科手術程序的整合系統。自1998年成立以來，本公司已投入大量資源用以發展基礎能力，以實現磁共振成像（"MRI"）引導介入的應用，建立智慧財產權組合，並識別及發展我們所開發技術的商業應用。2021年，我們的業務範疇擴展至MRI室以外，涵蓋神經外科手術器材產品的開發與商業化，以及為製藥公司提供的諮詢服務。
2025年，透過收購IRRAS Holdings, Inc.（"IRRAS"），我們將業務範疇擴展至神經重症照護領域。IRRAS為一家商業化階段的醫療科技公司，專注於治療顱內出血、腦室出血及其他需要顱內液體管理的疾病。
IRRAS的產品與本公司現有的神經外科技術相輔相成，並拓展我們在急性照護場域的業務，使我們能提供涵蓋功能性神經外科、神經重症照護及顱內藥物遞送的擴充解決方案。
本公司業務包含兩個整合的零組件：(i) 提供神經外科應用醫療器材的業務，以及 (ii) 聚焦於生物製品與藥物遞送領域的合作夥伴業務。
神經外科應用醫療器材
本公司業務的第一個基礎零組件為提供神經外科應用醫療器材。

我們的主要醫療器材產品為ClearPoint系統，為一整合系統，包含硬體零組件、一次性使用零組件及直覺、選單導向的軟體。ClearPoint系統的主要應用為目標導向並引導：(a) 深腦刺激電極、活檢針及雷射導管的插入；以及 (b) 藥物注入腦部。ClearPoint系統最初設計為在MRI環境中使用。2021年，我們發佈SmartFrame Array神經導航系統與軟體，使ClearPoint系統可在手術室中進行定位，並在MRI室內完成手術程序。2024年，我們將SmartFrame OR立體定位系統推向市場，使完整手術程序可在手術室中進行。2025年，我們發佈ClearPoint導航軟體版本3.0，使ClearPoint系統導航軟體可支援手術室內的端到端手術程序。
2022年，我們開始商業化ClearPoint Prism神經雷射治療系統，為一雷射消融系統。ClearPoint Prism神經雷射治療系統由CLS為我們開發及製造。我們擁有該系統在全球範疇內的獨家商業化權利。
2025 年，透過收購 IRRAS，我們將 IRRAflow Active Fluid Exchange System（"IRRAflow 系統"）加入我們的醫療器材產品組合。IRRAflow 系統整合連續灌注、引流及實時顱內壓力監測，以提供在神經重症照護及手術室環境中受控的自動化顱內液體管理。
我們業務的第二個零組件為聚焦於生物製劑與藥物遞送領域的合作夥伴關係，協助客戶從研究初期階段至臨牀試驗與商業化過程。自 2021 年起，我們業務收入中逐漸增加且顯著的部分來自於預臨牀開發服務，包含協議諮詢及預臨牀試驗設計與執行的解決方案。我們的諮詢服務包含一項核心專長為體內生物學服務，在大型與小型研究模型中協助客戶建立藥物安全性，以備其人類臨牀試驗之用。

目前，我們擁有超過 60 家藥廠／生物科技公司、學術機構及合同研究機構的合作夥伴，正在評估或使用我們的產品與服務於試驗中，直接將基因與細胞治療注入大腦。這些合作夥伴關係涉及的藥物開發計畫處於不同發展階段，從預臨牀研究至多種不同疾病狀態的晚期規範試驗。我們業務的這部分潛在代表最大的成長機會；然而，我們在這市場的成長能力，取決於我們維持並建立與藥廠客戶的新關係，這些客戶持續進行研究與產品開發計畫，這些客戶在完成臨牀試驗後取得其藥物與生物製劑的規範核准，以及這些客戶實現其治療的商業成功，包括克服報銷、醫生採用及患者取得治療的障礙。2024 年，美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）核准我們的 SmartFlow Neuro 管，用以將基因治療直接送達大腦特定區域，用以治療芳香族 L-胺基酸脫羧酶（"AADC"）缺乏症。
我們的 ClearPoint 系統為一整合系統，包含硬體零組件、一次性零組件及直覺、選單導向的軟體。
ClearPoint 硬體。我們的硬體零組件主要為頭部固定架、電腦工作站及室內顯示器。頭部固定架在手術過程中固定病患的頭部，並設計用以優化影像頭圈在病患頭部附近的放置位置。在 MRI 套裝中執行時，ClearPoint 系統軟體安裝於電腦工作站，並與 MRI 掃描儀網路連線，我們使用市售的筆記型電腦。室內顯示器讓醫生在掃描室內執行手術時，可觀看 ClearPoint 系統工作站的顯示畫面。

ClearPoint 一次性零組件。我們 ClearPoint 系統的一次性零組件主要為 SmartFrame 導引裝置系列、手控器及相關配件，以及 SmartFlow Neuro 管。SmartFrame 裝置為可調節的導引裝置，固定於病患頭顱上，並支撐導引針。在 MRI 中，手控器連接至 SmartFrame 裝置，醫生可利用其調整導引針的滾轉、俯仰及 X 與 Y 方向，而病患處於 MRI 掃描儀中。配件包含所有有助於影像導引神經外科手術的必要零組件，例如 SmartGrid 貼片，為一可被 MRI 視覺化的標記網格，可快速定位進入大腦的入口點，以及我們的客製化手術覆蓋布，可在 MRI 掃描儀內建立無菌區域。SmartFrame OR 立體定位系統為一次性使用且不需 MRI 導引的裝置。在藥物遞送程序中，我們的 SmartFlow Neuro 管為一與 MRI 兼容的注射與吸出管，作為遞送化合物的載具。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註一併閱讀，這些財務報表及附註載於本年度報告的其他部分。本討論與分析包含前瞻性陳述，這些陳述是基於目前的預期，並涉及風險、假設與不確定性。您應審閱本年度報告的「風險因素」部分，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與本討論與分析中所述或暗示的前瞻性陳述有重大差異的重要因素。

我們是一家商業階段的醫療器材公司，開發並商業化用於腦部微創神經外科手術的整合系統。我們投入大量資源，以資助我們開發基礎能力，用以實現MRI導引介入、建立智慧財產權組合，並識別並發展我們公司所開發技術的商業應用。在過去幾年，我們的業務能力已從MRI室擴展至包含手術室基於神經外科手術的器材產品，以及一個日益成長的服務組合，用以支持製藥與生物技術公司開發基因與細胞治療。2025年，透過收購IRRAS，我們將業務範疇擴展至神經重症照護，專注於治療腦內出血、腦室出血及其他需要顱內液體管理的狀況。
我們目前的業務由兩個整合的零組件組成：(i) 提供神經外科應用醫療器材的業務，以及 (ii) 聚焦於生物製品與藥物遞送領域的合作夥伴業務。

我們的主要醫療器材產品 ClearPoint 系統是一套整合系統，包含硬體零組件、一次性使用零組件與直覺、選單導向的軟體。ClearPoint 系統的主要應用為目標導向並引導：(a) 深腦刺激電極、活檢針與雷射導管的插入；以及 (b) 藥物注入腦部。ClearPoint 系統最初設計為在 MRI 環境中使用。2021年，我們發佈 SmartFrame Array 神經導航系統與軟體，允許在手術室中進行 ClearPoint 系統的放置並在 MRI 空間內完成手術。2024年，我們將 SmartFrame OR 立體定位系統推向市場，允許在手術室內完成完整的手術。2025年，我們發佈 ClearPoint 導航軟體 Version 3.0，允許 ClearPoint 系統導航軟體支援在手術室內進行端到端的手術。
2022年，我們開始商業化 ClearPoint Prism 神經雷射治療系統，這是一套雷射消融系統。ClearPoint Prism 神經雷射治療系統是由 CLS 為我們開發並製造。我們擁有該系統在全球範圍內用於神經應用的獨家商業化權。
2025年，透過收購 IRRAS，我們將 IRRAflow 系統加入我們的醫療器材產品組合。IRRAflow 系統整合連續灌注、引流與即時顱內壓力監測，以提供受控的自動化顱內液體管理，應用於神經重症照護與手術室環境中。

我們業務的第二個零組件聚焦於生物製品與藥物遞送領域的合作夥伴業務，支持我們的客戶從其研究的初期階段，一直到臨牀試驗與商業化過程。自2021年起，我們業務收入的一個日益成長且重要的部分來自於預臨牀開發服務，這些服務包括預臨牀試驗設計與執行的協議諮詢與解決方案。我們的諮詢服務包含在大型與小型研究模型中進行體內生物學服務的核心專業能力，以協助客戶在進行人類臨牀試驗前與支持其人類臨牀試驗時建立藥物安全性。

目前，我們擁有超過60家生物製品與藥物遞送客戶，正在評估使用我們的產品與服務在試驗中將基因與細胞治療直接注入腦部。這些合作夥伴涉及的藥物開發計畫處於不同發展階段，從預臨牀研究到多種不同疾病狀態的晚期臨牀試驗。我們業務的這一部分可能代表最大的成長機會；然而，我們在這個市場的成長能力，取決於我們維持並建立與製藥公司客戶的新關係的能力，這些客戶持續進行研究與產品開發計畫，這些客戶在完成臨牀試驗並取得其藥物與生物製品的後續監管批准，以及這些客戶實現其治療的商業成功，包括克服報銷、醫生採用與患者接觸其治療的障礙。2024年，美國食品藥物管理局（美國FDA）批准我們的 SmartFlow 導管用於遞送一種用於治療芳香族L-氨基酸脫羧酶缺乏症的基因治療藥物至腦部的特定區域。
• 完成對 IRRAS 的收購，將 IRRAflow 主動液體交換系統納入產品組合，為一項差異化技術，用以現代化顱內出血的管理。
• 與 Oberland Capital Management 的附屬公司簽訂債務融資安排，允許我們不時以分批方式借款最高 105.0 百萬美元；於 2025 年，我們透過此安排籌得約 48.1 百萬美元淨資金。
• 從向 Oberland Capital Management 的附屬公司出售本公司普通股股份，籌得約 3.3 百萬美元淨資金。
• 簽訂新預臨牀研究設施的租賃契約，該設施名為 ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL)，位於美國加州聖地牙哥，允許進行更大規模研究的額外容量，並能為生物製藥夥伴提供額外服務。
• 部分夥伴已通過預臨牀及臨牀審查，超過十家藥品製造商獲得美國 FDA 加速審查資格。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關的風險
我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果可能因總體經濟與金融市場狀況，以及目前及未來社會與地緣政治不穩定而受到負面影響。
若我們無法維持現有與藥物遞送客戶的關係或計畫，或與新客戶建立關係或計畫，我們的營業收入前景可能大幅下降。
我們產品與服務的市場規模，以及未來產品與服務的市場規模，可能小於我們的預估，且可能下降。
我們的 ClearPoint 系統與 IRRAflow 系統可能無法實現廣泛的市場採用。
IRRAflow 系統現有臨牀證據的限制可能影響臨牀與商業採用。
我們目前具有顯著的客戶集中度，因此若關鍵客戶遭遇經濟困難，或改變採購政策與模式，可能對我們的業務與營運成果產生重大影響。
我們依賴單一廠區進行製造與服務執行，這使我們面臨顯著的中斷風險。
本公司對零組件、成品及服務依賴單一來源供應商，可能影響本公司按時或符合預算滿足產品或服務需求之能力。
本公司在製造及提供服務過程中使用有害材料，可能使本公司面臨重大健康、安全、環境及法規風險。
若本公司尋求產品之新使用途徑或新主張，美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）可能不批准該新使用途徑或主張之510(k) clearance 或PMA approval，可能影響本公司拓展業務之能力。
若本公司未能取得新產品所需之核准、認證或批准，本公司在全球拓展業務之能力可能受損。
本公司銷售產品至美國境外，並受國際營運相關經濟、政治、法規及其他風險影響，可能損害本公司營業收入及獲利能力。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告中所包含的所有資訊，再決定是否購買本公司普通股。若任何下列風險或不確定性實際發生，將可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景造成重大影響。此外，任何上述風險或不確定性都可能導致本公司普通股的交易價格下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。下列所描述的事項反映本公司對可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與成長前景，以及/或本公司普通股未來價格產生重大且不利影響的因素、事件或意外情況的觀點與看法。本節所提及的過去事件或情況僅為範例，並非意圖提供完整清單，亦非表示下列所討論的因素、事件或意外情況是否已於過去發生，或其未來發生的可能性。
本節所提及的過去事件或情況僅為範例，並非意圖提供完整清單，亦非表示下列所討論的因素、事件或意外情況是否已於過去發生，或其未來發生的可能性。

國內與全球經濟條件的變化，例如持續的通貨膨脹壓力、較高的利率、貨幣政策的變化、消費者與企業信心與支出下降、供應鏈中斷、新興或變更的關稅或貿易壁壘，以及全球或地方性經濟衰退的潛在風險，可能會對我們產品與服務的需求造成不利影響，進而對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生負面影響。全球金融市場仍易受重大壓力影響，包括流動性減少與信貸取得困難、借款成本增加、外幣波動，以及證券價值的普遍波動。因此，我們未來在資本市場或其他資金來源取得資金的能力可能受到限制，或可能無法以商業上合理的條件取得，甚至完全無法取得。
通貨膨脹壓力與高利率可能提高我們在研究與開發、供應鏈、人力與其他行政費用的成本，進而提高我們產品與服務的生產與分銷成本。在這種環境下，我們可能無法足夠提高價格以彌補這些更高的成本。這些影響在我們業務中價格由長期契約安排所規範的領域可能更加顯著，因為我們可能無法迅速或輕易調整價格、降低費用或實施對策。

此外，我們的醫院、藥品與生物科技客戶可能因總體經濟條件而面臨更高的財務與營運壓力。這些壓力可能包括資金成本增加、減少對資本市場的存取、現金流困難，或難以遵守債務契約。這些情況可能進而影響我們醫院客戶提供病人照護的能力，或減少新資本設備與技術的預算。政府經費削減已進一步限制醫院與醫療體系的預算，這可能限制他們投資新技術的能動性，並延緩我們產品的採用。我們參與基因與細胞治療開發的藥品與生物科技客戶，可能面臨研究與開發經費減少，這可能減緩創新速度、延宕臨牀試驗，或限制商業化努力。任何客戶的限制都可能不利於他們購買我們產品與服務的意願或能力，或可能影響他們及時付款的能力，這兩種情況都可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響。此外，更廣泛的經濟不確定性、失業率升高，以及健康保險 premiums、共付額與免付額增加，可能導致成本意識強的消費者減少選擇性或先進醫療治療，這可能減少程序數量與對我們產品與服務的需求。

地緣政治變動與趨勢，例如民粹主義、保護主義、經濟民族主義，以及關稅、制裁和其他貿易限制，可能對我們的業務造成幹擾與成本增加。全球經濟已因持續的衝突，包括俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭、中東地區的不穩定，以及亞太地區，特別是中國與臺灣的緊張關係，而受到負面影響，並可能持續如此。這些發展可能幹擾我們的供應鏈、製造成本、對原材料的存取以及客戶關係。此外，因美國與外國貿易、經濟與規範政策的變動，可能因最近選舉後的政策調整而使各個地區的市場不確定性與波動性更加顯著。地緣政治的不確定性也促使許多藥品與生物科技公司傾向從位於其製造與研究作業附近，或其家園市場的供應商採購，作為減少安全風險與跨境幹擾的策略。如果我們無法配合這些偏好，或在關鍵市場建立足夠的本地存在，我們對某些國際客戶的競爭力可能下降。儘管我們的絕大多數業務都位於美國，但地緣政治緊張關係的進一步升級，可能使維持現有國際業務或拓展至更多市場變得更加昂貴或困難，這可能對我們的業務、財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響。
